# Nayab — Live Demo of llmizeOFF

> Nayab is the hosted demo of llmizeOFF, a self-hosted LLM runtime. Free tier runs Llama 3.2 1B on a private server. Paid plan unlocks GPT-4o and Claude Sonnet.

## About

Nayab is a ChatGPT-style web app built to showcase llmizeOFF — an open-source library for running llama.cpp inference on any Node.js host (VPS, cPanel, Android, local machines).

URL: https://zulqurnainj.com/chat
llmizeOFF on GitHub: https://github.com/Zulqurnain/llmizeoff
Built by: Zulqurnain Haider (https://zulqurnainj.com)

## Features

- Real token streaming
- File upload support (PDF, TXT, RTF, PNG, JPG — 1 MB max)
- Text to speech (browser-native)
- Optional web search via DuckDuckGo
- Model selection for paid users
- Privacy-first: no persistent storage of chats or files
- 4 free prompts without sign-up, then free account required

## Models

Free: Self-hosted llmizeOFF runtime (Llama 3.2 1B)
Free: Groq Llama 3.1 8B (cloud, sub-1-second)
Paid: GPT-4o, GPT-4o Mini (OpenAI)
Paid: Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Claude 3 Haiku (Anthropic)

## Plans

Free: Self-hosted llmizeOFF model (Llama 3.2 1B) — unlimited with free account
Paid: $10 one-time via Gumroad — unlocks GPT-4o, Claude, and other models
